text:
vivian (design): quick thought — compact spend rows are landing but folks ask for a low-friction peek at token splits. two patterns on the table: a tiny inline "peek pill" anchored in the token cell (hover / focus) vs a persistent "expand chip" that opens a right-hand drawer. which is better for org vs project scopes?
omar (frontend): both doable. inline pill is nicer for quick glances but could be expensive if we hydrate charts across many rows. plan: keep a minimal DOM footprint, lazy-fetch details on interaction, render sparklines to canvas. drawer path can reuse existing invoice API and is heavier but simpler.
rei (pm): important product constraint: previews should not expose full invoice downloads inline to avoid accidental billing actions. inline peek = summary + top-3 splits; drawer = full invoice & download. we'll AB test to see which leads to more conversions.
hana (infra): backend guardrails: we must avoid per-hover QPS spikes. add a batch preview endpoint to accept multiple row ids, client-side debounce 200ms, and a small per-user LRU cache (TTL 4m). also add a throttle so one user can only make N preview calls per minute.
dylan (data): metrics proposal: log `billing.peek.opened` with fields: variant (pill|drawer), method (hover|focus|click|keyboard), scope (org|project), row_type (project|endpoint), preview_load_ms, preview_to_drawer_ms, invoice_downloaded (bool). primary metric: conversion to invoice_open per preview.
ada (a11y): accessibility rules: inline peek must be focusable. include a small `<button class="peek-pill">` inside cell with `aria-controls="peek-{row}"` and toggled `aria-expanded`. the preview region should be `role=region` and `aria-live=polite` for dynamic loads. keyboard flow: Tab -> pill -> Enter opens inline preview -> Tab navigates preview content -> Esc closes and returns focus to pill. drawer should trap focus when open.
vivian (design): copy / microcopy: pill label = "Peek" (very short). preview header = "Tokens — last 30 days" (em dash). drawer CTA = "View invoice" (secondary) and "Download" only in drawer. small note: pluralize Tokens consistently.
omar (frontend): implementation detail: render a lightweight `.peek-shell` for each row that is empty until interaction. on mouseenter/focus start 120ms timer; after that, request preview payload. cancel if mouse leaves. sparklines single-pixel height for compactness. respect `prefers-reduced-motion`.
hana (infra): server note: batch endpoint `/billing/preview/batch` accepts `row_ids[]` and optional `scope=org|project`. returns compact payload: top3 names + token_counts + small sparkline arrays. we'll compress responses and set edge caching for identical requests.
dylan (data): experiment design: randomize by user to variant `pill_inline` vs `drawer_explicit`. track accidental opens (preview opened but closed < 300ms) and backend_preview_qps. also record method to see keyboard vs hover usage.
ada (a11y): one more: include a visually-hidden summary `id=peek-summary-{row}` and have the pill `aria-describedby` point at it so SR users get the breakdown without tabbing into the preview. also announce failures with `role=alert` and provide a retry button.
vivian (design): visual constraints: preview must not shift row height — use an overlay/popover anchored to cell or a tiny floating panel. in org scope preview show top-3 projects; in project scope show top-3 endpoints. use consistent row heights and conservative typography so numbers remain readable.
omar (frontend): rough dev estimate: pill inline + lazy load + analytics + feature flag = 4 dev days. drawer variant reuse = 2 days. plus client caching code.
hana (infra): infra estimate: batch preview endpoint + per-user LRU cache + global throttle ~ 1.5 days.
dylan (data): I'll add the events to the analytics schema and set up dashboards for preview conversion funnel.
ci-bot: :white_check_mark: staging smoke passed 2026-03-29T18:02Z — basic peek-shell render tests OK
rei (pm): action items: viv update Figma frames for both patterns with copy; omar start feature branches behind flags; hana add server guardrails; dylan wire analytics; ada write a11y acceptance checklist. we'll run 5% rollout then iterate.
vivian (design): thanks everyone — i'll drop updated frames and the experiment ticket in this thread shortly :sparkles:
